# Q — Data, BI & Automation Systems

> Q (Adul Sa-a) builds inspectable data, business-intelligence and automation
> systems. This portfolio presents public GitHub work as evidence-led case
> studies: every material claim links to code, tests or a committed artifact,
> and simulated, reconstructed or README-reported material is labelled as such.

Site: https://adulsaa-q.pages.dev/
Source of record: https://github.com/adulsaa-q
Contact: work enquiries via https://adulsaa-q.pages.dev/contact/

## What Q does

- Dashboard and decision reporting (Power BI, Power Query/M, DAX)
- Data pipelines and operational automation (Python, PostgreSQL, ETL)
- AI research and workflow systems with visible sources and authority limits

## Projects

- Multi-Channel E-commerce Sales Pipeline — Power Query/M + Power BI model that
  aligns Shopee, Lazada and advertising exports into one reporting layer.
  Evidence: verified code (Power Query, DAX register), committed dashboard
  images. Sample data is synthetic/anonymised; no client outcome is claimed.
  https://github.com/adulsaa-q/ecommerce-sales-pipeline

- Shopee Thailand Analytics — SQL analysis modules and a documented Power BI/DAX
  model for sales, customers, campaigns and delivery. Uses a simulated
  marketplace dataset; README-reported figures are not independently reproduced.
  https://github.com/adulsaa-q/shopee-thailand-analytics

- Finance ETL Pipeline — Python pipeline design that extracts KBank e-statements,
  validates transactions and loads PostgreSQL idempotently with audit records.
  Evidence: verified code and a unit/integration test suite. KBank-specific
  parser scope; no live-credential run is demonstrated.
  https://github.com/adulsaa-q/finance-etl-pipeline

- TIMELIMIT — Electron/TypeScript offline desktop widget for long-term
  deadlines, using timestamp-based time calculation and atomic local
  persistence. Evidence: verified code, five Vitest files (27 cases),
  committed UI screenshots. Portfolio code, not a hardened release.
  https://github.com/adulsaa-q/timelimit

## Evidence classes used on this site

VERIFIED_CODE, VERIFIED_TEST, VERIFIED_ARTIFACT, README_REPORTED, SIMULATED,
EXPERIMENTAL, PLANNED, UNKNOWN.

## Not claimed anywhere on this site

Named clients, revenue or ROI figures, production usage, user counts,
testimonials, certifications, or security guarantees.
